title: Titanium Neuro Guidewire
alloyReason: Nitinol (Nickel-Titanium Shape Memory Alloy, ASTM F2063) provides unique superelasticity and shape memory effect, enabling self-expanding stents, kink-resistant guidewires, and deployable medical devices. Its elastic recoverable strain (up to 8%) is orders of magnitude higher than any conventional metal.
commonFailures: Surface contamination from iron pickup during machining requiring acid passivation (ASTM F86)

faq.q: What is a titanium neuro guidewire?
faq.a: A titanium neuro guidewire is a precision-machined interventional component used in neurovascular micro-guidewire core (nitinol). Manufactured from Nitinol (ASTM F2063) for optimal strength, corrosion resistance, and weight savings.

faq.q: How is titanium neuro guidewire delivered?
faq.a: Titanium Neuro Guidewire (Nitinol) is manufactured in its expanded shape, compressed into its delivery catheter, and self-expands at body temperature (37C) upon deployment. Fatigue testing exceeds 400 million cycles (10-year equivalent).

faq.q: How is titanium neuro guidewire manufactured?
faq.a: Titanium Neuro Guidewire is manufactured using Laser micro-cutting. Critical process controls include tool path optimization, coolant temperature management, and dimensional verification at each operation.

faq.q: What is the most common issue with titanium neuro guidewire?
faq.a: The most common issue is surface contamination from iron pickup during machining requiring acid passivation (astm f86). Mitigation includes proper process control, material certification, and adherence to recommended installation procedures and torque values.

faq.q: What is the lead time for titanium neuro guidewire?
faq.a: Standard lead time: 2-4 weeks depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders available. Contact our team with your drawing and quantity for an accurate delivery quote.
